individualTimeline: Episode 73: Milo is selected as one of the first three Kairos Academy Green players.
Episode 74: Milo begins working under Head Coach Stewie2K with no permanent position assigned.
Episode 91: During final role-selection training before the institutional break, Milo is voted into the Entry Rifler role; Captain remains explicitly unassigned.

Episode 93: Returning from the 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03 institutional break, Milo's updated nickname (velcroDAWG, replacing velcrodog) becomes current; his Entry Rifler role is reconfirmed as current.
Episode 117 (2027-01-28): Stewie2K tells the Academy he is leaving for Without a Roof; Tarik is appointed Head Coach of Kairos Academy Green and introduced that evening.
trivia: The nickname originated after Milo saw a dog with a piece of Velcro stuck in its fur when he was eleven.
His current nickname, velcroDAWG, is a stylistic restyling of the same idea, not a new origin.
